title: COMMUNITY HEALTH SYSTEMS INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Community Health Systems, Inc. (CYH) filed an 8-K on April 22, 2026, announcing a tender offer by its wholly owned subsidiary CHS/Community Health Systems, Inc. to repurchase up to $600,000,000 aggregate purchase price of two series of its outstanding senior secured notes: 4.750% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 and 10.875% Senior Secured Notes due 2032.
key_points: Company: Community Health Systems, Inc. (ticker CYH, NYSE-listed)
Tender offer amount: up to $600,000,000 aggregate purchase price
Notes subject to tender: 4.750% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 and 10.875% Senior Secured Notes due 2032
Filing signed by Jason K. Johnson, Executive Vice President and CFO
